subject: Culture
title: Social Credit Systems
description: A micro-lesson that makes Social Credit Systems usable.

hook.text: In parts of China, jaywalking lowers your social credit score, blocking you from buying train tickets.

buildup.text: China's social credit system launched in 2014 to rate trustworthiness of citizens and businesses.

discovery.text: It digitized what villages always did: track reputation. But now algorithms replace gossip networks.

twist.text: Western credit scores do the same thing—they just measure financial behavior instead of social behavior.

climax.text: Every rating app—Uber, Airbnb, Yelp—is a micro social credit system we volunteered for.

punchline.text: We all live in a rating economy now.

quiz.question: When did China's social credit system officially launch?
